name: apko
title: Apko
notes: Installs the CLI; APK repositories, build privileges, image config, and registry credentials belong to the pipeline.

name: artifactory
title: Artifactory
notes: Installs JFrog CLI; configure an authenticated server before upload/download operations.

name: azure
title: Azure
notes: Uses native repositories; configure the vendor repository first for tools absent from the distribution repository. Pinned versions must be available in that repository.

name: binaryen
title: Binaryen
notes: Installs Binaryen command-line tools, including wasm-opt and wasm-merge.

name: buf
title: buf
notes: Installs the official versioned CLI release for the current host OS and CPU.

name: cachix
title: Cachix
notes: Uses native repositories; configure the vendor repository first for tools absent from the distribution repository. Pinned versions must be available in that repository.

name: devbox
title: Devbox
notes: Devbox requires Nix for creating development environments; use setup-nix first. Setup installs only the versioned Devbox CLI.

name: devenv
title: Devenv
notes: Requires an existing Nix installation with flakes support. Installs the pinned upstream flake into a private profile; configure trusted caches separately.

name: docker
title: Docker
notes: Uses native repositories; configure the vendor repository first for tools absent from the distribution repository. Pinned versions must be available in that repository.

name: dpkg
title: Dpkg
notes: Linux only; installs the native packaging toolchain. Uses native repositories; configure the vendor repository first for tools absent from the distribution repository. Pinned versions must be available in that repository.

name: expo
title: Expo CLI
notes: Installs the current @expo/cli package, not the deprecated expo-cli. Version selects the CLI release, not the Expo SDK. Projects must already contain a compatible expo dependency. Native iOS builds require macOS and Xcode; Android builds require an Android SDK/JDK.

name: extism
title: Extism
notes: Installs Extism CLI, JavaScript/Python compilers, XTP CLI, and Binaryen. Component versions can be selected independently.

name: flakehub-push
title: FlakeHub Push
notes: Requires an existing Nix installation with flakes support. Version selects an upstream release tag (for example 7 or v7), not the publisher Cargo version. Installs that pinned flake in a private profile and checks executability without invoking authenticated publishing commands. The returned version is the selected release. GitHub OIDC credentials are required only when publishing.

name: flox
title: Flox
notes: macOS uses the official Homebrew flox formula. Linux requires a configured package source providing Flox, or installation of the official Flox .deb/.rpm first. Pinned releases must exist in that package source. Native package installs require appropriate privileges; setup does not configure vendor repositories.

name: gcloud
title: Google Cloud
notes: Uses native repositories; configure the vendor repository first for tools absent from the distribution repository. Pinned versions must be available in that repository.

name: gemfury
title: Gemfury
notes: Installs curl, the transport used by the Gemfury upload module; account credentials remain in the host environment. Uses native repositories; configure the vendor repository first for tools absent from the distribution repository. Pinned versions must be available in that repository.

name: gh-artifact
title: Gh-Artifact
notes: Installs gh for artifact/release downloads; Actions job-artifact uploads additionally use the GitHub artifact client installed by this setup module.

name: nexus
title: Nexus
notes: Installs curl for Nexus raw-repository transfers. Authentication uses a private curl config/netrc file.

name: pkgx
title: Pkgx
notes: Installs the pkgx launcher. Packages requested later by pkgx have their own platform availability and network requirements.

name: podman
title: Podman
notes: Uses native repositories; configure the vendor repository first for tools absent from the distribution repository. Pinned versions must be available in that repository.

name: protolint
title: protolint
notes: Installs the official versioned CLI release for the current host OS and CPU.

name: railpack
title: Railpack
notes: BuildKit is required for railpack build; planning and metadata commands do not need a daemon.

name: rpmbuild
title: Rpmbuild
notes: Linux only; installs the native packaging toolchain. Uses native repositories; configure the vendor repository first for tools absent from the distribution repository. Pinned versions must be available in that repository.

name: rustfmt
title: Rustfmt
notes: version selects a Rust toolchain, not an independent rustfmt release.

name: shellcheck
title: ShellCheck
notes: Uses native repositories; configure the vendor repository first for tools absent from the distribution repository. Pinned versions must be available in that repository.

name: sqlfluff
title: sqlfluff
notes: Requires Python 3 with venv support; installs core SQLFluff into an isolated environment. Optional templater adapters require additional dependencies.

name: sqruff
title: Sqruff
notes: Installs the official versioned Sqruff binary. Linux uses the upstream musl archive for x86_64 or aarch64; macOS uses the matching Darwin archive.

name: tangled-artifacts
title: Tangled-Artifacts
notes: Installs the annotated-tag asset uploader; it is independent of tg. Keep TNGL_UPLOADER_APP_PASSWORD in the host environment.

name: tg
title: Tg
notes: Installs aly.codes/tg, the Tangled terminal client. Authentication remains in its native configuration.

name: wrangler
title: Cloudflare Wrangler
notes: Installs the Wrangler npm package through Bun. Requires a Node.js release supported by the selected Wrangler version; missing Node.js and Bun are bootstrapped. Cloudflare credentials remain in the CI environment.

name: xtp
title: Xtp
notes: Installs the official XTP CLI from static.dylibso.com. No authentication or plugin publication is performed.
